newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - New storm halts movement.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - New storm halts movement.

text.p: A new winter storm brought more snow and halted some grain movement Wednesday across the northern Plains, merchandisers said.
"Way up north around Grand Forks they were talking three or four inches. The biggest problem is blowing snow. Some places earlier this morning had zero visibility," one Minneapolis grain dealer said.
"It was really terrible a couple of hours ago, but now it's stopping and people are starting to dig out," a merchandiser in the Red River Valley area of North Dakota said.

Basis levels for 14 percent protein spring wheat for delivery into Minneapolis were weaker Wednesday, but basis levels remained mostly unchanged across the rest of the northern Plains and in the Pacific Northwest.
MGE March spring wheat rose 3-1/2 cents per bushel Wednesday on commercial buying, traders said.
Dealers in Montana said farmer sales increased Wednesday as a result of the higher March futures contract.
